companies.thesis: Vertiv builds the power gear next to the GPU rack — sidecars, busways, and backup — so operators can feed 800 V DC into dense AI racks without ripping out the whole facility at once. Its PowerDirect 5000-class sidecar path and NVIDIA collaboration put it on the near-term rack transition (optional Vera Rubin H2 2026; volume ~Rubin Ultra H2 2027), while facility-wide DC halls remain a later (~2029+) chapter. Digest routing: Sep 24, 2026 agreement to acquire King Environmental Services (EMEA fluid management / commissioning / load-testing); close targeted Q4 2026; terms undisclosed / not expected to be material.
companies.street: Street leaning: Moderate Buy (MarketBeat consensus, late Sep 2026).

companies.thesis: Eaton’s medium-voltage solid-state transformer (SST) converts grid AC straight toward low-voltage DC — including 800 VDC for AI halls — skipping some classic conversion stages. A September 2026 deal has Infineon supplying silicon carbide (SiC) devices for MVSST 2.0 in Asia-Pacific, with higher-voltage (2.3–3.3 kV) SiC modules on the roadmap. Certification (including UL 2877-class SST norms) and HV SiC supply remain industry bottlenecks.

companies.thesis: Bloom’s solid oxide fuel cells (SOFCs) make electricity on site from natural gas, biogas, or hydrogen — useful when the utility interconnection queue is the bottleneck. Output is inherently DC-friendly before conversion, which pairs conceptually with high-voltage DC halls, though today’s deployments still plug into standard facility power designs. Oracle’s expanded master agreement (up to 2.8 GW; Project Jupiter NM up to ~2.45 GW discussed) is the clearest hyperscaler signal on this list. Risk (press, ~24–25 Sep 2026): Oracle reportedly issued a force-majeure notice on Project Jupiter to preserve rights if the NM campus slips vs a ~2028 online plan — framed as payment-timing protection, not an exit; gas-pipeline/permitting delays remain a live feedstock risk. Secondary press, not a court finding.
companies.street: Street leaning: Buy (stockanalysis BE consensus, ~22 analysts).
companies.stanceNote: Keep Accumulate / gold with risk callout: late-Sep 2026 Project Jupiter force-majeure headlines, pipeline/permit timing, dilution, gas feedstock.

companies.thesis: ABB’s Infinitus portfolio targets source-to-rack 800 V DC for AI data centers: SST-based conversion, DC distribution, and solid-state DC protection. The SACE Infinitus solid-state circuit breaker (IEC 60947-2 class messaging; high amp / ~1.25 kV DC class) matters because DC fault clearing is harder than AC. Components guided toward production within ~12 months; full DC-native halls more like 2–3 years.

That solves megawatts at the fence line, not the 800 V DC rack bus — complementary to Vertiv/Delta rather than a substitute. On the fuel-cell side, MHI’s MEGAMIE SOFC–microturbine hybrid and separate Honda/Mitsubishi hydrogen demos (~1 MW class) are interesting but not yet GW-scale contracted books like Bloom’s SOFC backlog.

companies.thesis: Amphenol makes the plugs and busbar interfaces that carry high current safely — including higher-voltage DC paths as racks move toward 800 V DC. Industrial lines (RADSOK / Voltarius-class, busbar terminations) and data-center connectivity brochures emphasize touch-safe, high-amp interconnects for AI power and cooling. It is a picks-and-shovels connector bet: content grows with rack kilowatts, but ASPs are smaller than SST or sidecar systems.
